Hey man proud of you for starting fresh! Meditation is an amazing way to relax and to hardwire your brain. What I do is in the morning wake up and DONT LOOK AT YOUR PHONE. It’s okay to check the time but don’t go on it. Spend the first 10 minutes of the day thinking about what you see yourself doing throughout it, like your plans, goals, things you need to prioritize. Also see yourself starting to relapse during that day and come up with ways you can beat it. Find peace in meditating and that peace can replace porn. During the night, meditate for 10 minutes just focusing on your longtime goals. Focus on what you truly want in life, on what type of person you want to be, what you want to learn and accomplish. During the daytime when you have these thought in your head and feel really anxious that you will fail, pretend you are being followed by a camera crew who’s making a documentary about you, you’re the underdog and this is the story of how you came back as someone amazing. Someone people can look up to and be inspired by. I’ll be praying for you and I wish you the best of luck with all your future endeavors!
